package external

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"

	"github.com/2comjie/nova/diff"
	"github.com/2comjie/nova/internal/diffgen/testdata/basic"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2/bson"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
)

func TestCodecs(t *testing.T) {
	for _, codec := range []struct {
		name      string
		marshal   func(any) ([]byte, error)
		unmarshal func([]byte, any) error
	}{
		{"json", json.Marshal, json.Unmarshal},
		{"bson", bson.Marshal, bson.Unmarshal},
	} {
		t.Run(codec.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			writer := diff.NewWriter()
			source := new(Model)
			source.InitLink(writer)
			source.SetState(basic.Running)
			child := new(basic.Child)
			child.SetCount(7)
			source.SetChild(child)
			source.Children().Store(1, child)
			source.Order().Append(child)
			source.Order().Append(nil)
			nested := new(basic.Model)
			nested.SetChild(child)
			nested.Scores().Store(18446744073709551615, 11)
			source.SetBasic(nested)
			patches := writer.Len()
			body, err := codec.marshal(source)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if writer.Len() != patches {
				t.Fatal("marshal changed patches")
			}
			replica := new(Model)
			replicaWriter := diff.NewWriter()
			replica.InitLink(replicaWriter)
			if err := codec.unmarshal(body, replica); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !proto.Equal(source.Snapshot(), replica.Snapshot()) || replicaWriter.Len() != 0 {
				t.Fatal("codec round trip lost state or emitted patches", replica.Snapshot())
			}
			child.SetCount(99)
			if replica.GetChild().GetCount() != 7 || replica.Order().GetValue(1) != nil {
				t.Fatal("decoded state aliases source or lost nil slot")
			}
			replica.GetChild().SetCount(8)
			mapChild, _ := replica.Children().Load(1)
			mapChild.SetCount(9)
			replica.Order().GetValue(0).SetCount(10)
			replica.GetBasic().GetChild().SetCount(11)
			if replicaWriter.Len() != 4 {
				t.Fatal("decoded parent links are broken")
			}
			replicaWriter.Reset()
			before := replica.Snapshot()
			bad, err := codec.marshal(map[string]any{"Child": map[string]any{"Count": 45}, "Basic": map[string]any{"level": "invalid"}})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := codec.unmarshal(bad, replica); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid field type accepted")
			}
			if !proto.Equal(before, replica.Snapshot()) || replicaWriter.Len() != 0 {
				t.Fatal("failed decoding modified the existing object")
			}
			if err := codec.unmarshal([]byte{1, 2, 3}, replica); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("malformed bytes accepted")
			}
			if !proto.Equal(before, replica.Snapshot()) {
				t.Fatal("malformed bytes modified object")
			}
			empty, err := codec.marshal(map[string]any{})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			old := replica.GetChild()
			if err := codec.unmarshal(empty, replica); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			old.SetCount(100)
			mapChild.SetCount(100)
			if replica.GetChild() != nil || replica.Children().Len() != 0 || replica.Order().Len() != 0 || replicaWriter.Len() != 0 {
				t.Fatal("full decode retained old values or old links")
			}
			nulls, err := codec.marshal(map[string]any{"Children": map[string]any{"1": nil}})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := codec.unmarshal(nulls, replica); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if replica.Children().Len() != 0 {
				t.Fatal("null object-map entry must be absent")
			}

			collections := new(basic.Collections)
			collections.Runtime = "keep"
			collections.Signed().Store(-128, -32768)
			collections.Unsigned().Store(65535, 255)
			collections.Flags().Store(false, "no")
			collections.Flags().Store(true, "yes")
			collections.Floats().Store("speed", 1.5)
			collections.Doubles().Append(2.25)
			collections.Counts().Append(-5)
			collections.Bytes().Append(255)
			body, err = codec.marshal(collections)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			copy := new(basic.Collections)
			copy.Runtime = "retained"
			if err := codec.unmarshal(body, copy); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !proto.Equal(collections.Snapshot(), copy.Snapshot()) || copy.Runtime != "retained" {
				t.Fatal("collection values or runtime state changed")
			}
			bad, err = codec.marshal(map[string]any{"Flags": map[string]string{"invalid": "bad"}})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := codec.unmarshal(bad, copy); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid bool key accepted")
			}
			if !proto.Equal(collections.Snapshot(), copy.Snapshot()) {
				t.Fatal("invalid key modified data")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestCodecTags(t *testing.T) {
	value := new(basic.CodecTags)
	value.SetUid(1001)
	value.SetJSONOnly(10)
	value.SetBSONOnly(20)
	value.SetHidden(30)
	value.Runtime = "internal"
	jsonBody, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var jsonFields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(jsonBody, &jsonFields); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(jsonFields) != 2 || string(jsonFields["uid"]) != "1001" || string(jsonFields["json_only"]) != "10" {
		t.Fatal("JSON tags ignored or internal state encoded", string(jsonBody))
	}
	bsonBody, err := bson.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var bsonFields bson.M
	if err := bson.Unmarshal(bsonBody, &bsonFields); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(bsonFields) != 2 || bsonFields["_id"] != int64(1001) || bsonFields["bson_only"] != int32(20) {
		t.Fatal("BSON tags ignored or internal state encoded", bsonFields)
	}
	restored := new(basic.CodecTags)
	restored.Runtime = "preserved"
	restored.SetHidden(99)
	if err := json.Unmarshal(jsonBody, restored); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if restored.GetUid() != 1001 || restored.GetJSONOnly() != 10 || restored.GetBSONOnly() != 0 || restored.GetHidden() != 0 || restored.Runtime != "preserved" {
		t.Fatal("JSON full load ignored tags or lost runtime fields")
	}
	if err := bson.Unmarshal(bsonBody, restored); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if restored.GetJSONOnly() != 0 || restored.GetBSONOnly() != 20 || restored.Runtime != "preserved" {
		t.Fatal("BSON full load ignored tags or lost runtime fields")
	}
	value.SetUid(18446744073709551615)
	if _, err := json.Marshal(value); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := bson.Marshal(value); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("BSON unsigned overflow silently accepted")
	}
}
